fresh_rule.definition: A part is FRESH iff it never appeared in any tuning or evaluation before (not Gold11, Gold37, physical15 or other-consumed per BENCHMARK_V2.json and merged_inventory.json). Split is per part, never per scan.
fresh_rule.use: FRESH truth is for the single final evaluation only, with one frozen engine config hash. Never for tuning, thresholds, label edits, case selection or any accuracy-loop look. If FRESH truth or results are looked at earlier, or the engine changes after the FRESH run, those parts become CONSUMED and the run is reported as such.
fresh_rule.labeling_note: Labeling agents looked at FRESH scans to create truth (truth creation is not tuning). The engine/accuracy loop must never read FRESH scans, labels or lines dirs.
fresh_rule.non_sealed_policy: This manifest and BENCHMARK_V3.md list FRESH scans with split, truth source and status only. Per-scan FRESH bend counts, line geometry, CAD comparisons and judge details are only in fresh_SEALED/BENCHMARK_V3_FRESH_SEALED.json.

rules.split_unit: part (SKU). A part is FRESH only if every known file of it is prior_use=fresh. Any consumed or unknown-provenance file makes the whole part CONSUMED. Fresh-looking files of a consumed part stay CONSUMED.
rules.consumed_definition: Gold11, Gold37, physical15, any other development/F1-tuning use (other-consumed), and unknown provenance.
rules.fresh_once_rule: FRESH is evaluated ONCE, at the end of the accuracy loop, with one frozen engine config hash. FRESH results must never feed back into tuning, thresholds, label edits or case selection. If FRESH is looked at earlier, or the engine changes after the FRESH run, those parts become CONSUMED and the run is reported as such.
rules.gold11_note: Gold11 is CONSUMED. The engine was tuned on it, so a green result there is expected and is not evidence of accuracy on unseen parts. Before scoring, each Gold label set in reference_mesh_raw must have its raw-to-reference transform recovered (residual <= 0.01 mm) and scoring happens in the raw-scan frame (plan s10 amendment 6(a)). Cases without a recoverable transform are listed and excluded before scoring.
rules.ai_gold_gate: AI_GOLD_ACCEPTED requires that an independent verifier agent actually saw the rendered line overlays, every line lands (yes), none is no/unclear, and zero visible bends are missed. Labels whose verifier saw no images are NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW even when the upstream step reported accepted=true.
rules.review11_owner_delegated: 2026-10-17: the owner delegated the final verdict on the 11 scans left in NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW to the AI review (investigator, 2 blind verifiers, judge, final pass). Statuses: AI_GOLD_ACCEPTED, AI_GOLD_PARTIAL (label_complete=false: some real folds unlabelled; not usable as a line-F1 denominator), REJECTED_UNUSABLE, REJECTED_NOT_A_SCAN (role EXCLUDED_NOT_A_SCAN, out of the benchmark). Still AI-adjudicated, not human.
rules.synthetic_demo_exclusions: 2026-10-17: live_scans/*_LIDAR_DEMO_<stamp>.ply files are synthetic resamples of test_files/<part>/scan.stl made by the legacy /api/live-scan/demo/load endpoint (Open3D header, xyz only, ~14000 or 12000 points minus 6% dropout, N(0, 0.08 mm) jitter, mtime = name stamp). They are role EXCLUDED_NOT_A_SCAN, out of every benchmark count. Their AI label files stay on disk; scorers must skip the scan ids listed in the exclusions file.

truth_tiers.AI_GOLD_ACCEPTED: this run's AI vision labels that passed the strict gate; adjudicated by agents, not humans
truth_tiers.GOLD_LINES_AI_LEGACY: earlier Codex manual-multiview labels (tiers codex_manual_multiview_*). Studio files under human_bend_lines_v1 are Codex imports, not human labels
truth_tiers.CAD_RECIPE: nominal bends from a STEP CAD (V10 extractor / DEV_AUTO_CONFIRMED recipe). Gives design intent (count, nominal angle), not where a given scan's bend lies, and says nothing about staged scans until stage is decided. Not compiled by this manifest

rules.custody: HOLDOUT10, sealed truth, opaque N001-N014, EHO4, authorization/one-shot artifacts and held-out manifests are absent: excluded upstream by name/manifest membership and never opened. Eyal-50 delivery files are quarantined (locked-holdout split unread).
